boards.title: Your First Weekend at The University of Tampa, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe first-weekend route that starts on campus and extends along Tampa’s public riverfront.

cards.title: Start with Plant Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · UTampa campus
cards.notes: Begin with the landmark at the center of UTampa’s campus route. Use the self-guided-tour page and campus map to orient yourself before exploring nearby buildings.
cards.short_summary: A practical first landmark for getting your bearings on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa’s self-guided tour identifies Plant Hall as No. 53 and says the University relocated there in 1933; it now contains admissions, financial-aid offices and classrooms.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour | The University of Tampa
cards.access_notes: Follow UTampa visitor guidance and carry identification; access to areas may be limited.

cards.title: Find the student-life hub
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · UTampa campus
cards.notes: Step into the Vaughn Center to locate student-facing offices, meeting spaces and dining options. It is a sensible checkpoint before deciding what to do later in the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A central campus stop for services, organizations and food options.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa describes the nine-story Vaughn Center as the hub of student life and activity, with campus offices, dining venues, bookstore and student-organization spaces.
cards.source_title: About the Vaughn Center | The University of Tampa
cards.access_notes: Use the building’s public student-service areas; follow posted access rules for residential floors and offices.

cards.entity_name: Benson Alex Riseman Fitness and Recreation Center
cards.title: Make a recreation plan
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · UTampa campus
cards.notes: Tour the recreation center and choose a straightforward activity for another day, such as cardio, a group class or basketball. Check facility rules and current eligibility before entering.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation stop with fitness, courts and group-activity options.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa says its 130,000-square-foot fitness center supports exercise programs, intramurals, recreation activities and club sports, and includes basketball and beach-volleyball courts.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and activities are subject to Campus Recreation eligibility, policies and schedules.

cards.title: Save a pool session for Saturday
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · UTampa campus
cards.notes: If you are eligible to use the facility, check the aquatic schedule and plan a daylight swim or pool-deck break. Bring appropriate swim gear and follow posted pool rules.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus aquatic facility with lap and leisure pools.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa describes the Riseman Aquatic Center as having a competition lap pool, leisure pool, spa and sun deck for UTampa students, faculty and staff.
cards.source_title: Riseman Aquatic Center | The University of Tampa
cards.access_notes: Check current aquatic hours and eligibility before going; the facility’s stated users are UTampa students, faculty and staff.

cards.title: Borrow a bike for a daytime ride
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Based at the Riseman Center
cards.notes: Use a valid Spartan ID to arrange a daily bike rental, then choose a daylight route that fits your comfort level. Return the bike according to program procedures.
cards.short_summary: A university bike-rental activity for campus-community members.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa says BikeUTampa is a University-wide free bike-rental program, housed at the Riseman Fitness and Recreation Center, for daily rentals with a valid Spartan ID.
cards.source_title: Transportation Resources | The University of Tampa
cards.access_notes: A valid Spartan ID is required; confirm availability, route conditions and program procedures before departing.

cards.title: Walk the waterfront
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Downtown Tampa
cards.notes: Continue with a daylight walk, bike ride or seated break along the riverfront. Use the City’s Riverwalk map to pick a section and identify parks or museums you want to revisit.
cards.short_summary: A public waterfront route linking downtown parks, museums and attractions.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa’s Riverwalk page lists parks, museums, public art and attractions along the Tampa Riverwalk.
cards.access_notes: Use daylight hours and follow City park rules and any posted event restrictions.

cards.title: Pause at Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Tampa Riverwalk
cards.notes: Make this a rest stop on the Riverwalk: sit in the open park area, take photos of the waterfront and check nearby cultural venues for their own current visiting details.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown park directly listed on the Riverwalk route.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa lists Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park among the parks on the Tampa Riverwalk.
cards.access_notes: Follow posted park rules and event-area instructions.

cards.title: Add an art-museum option
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Tampa Riverwalk
cards.notes: If the museum is open and you want an indoor stop, check its official visit information before heading in. Otherwise, note its Riverwalk location for a later planned visit.
cards.short_summary: A named museum option along the downtown Riverwalk.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa lists the Tampa Museum of Art among museums along the Tampa Riverwalk.
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s official site for current admission, hours and exhibit access before visiting.

cards.title: Circle back to the Plant-era museum
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Tampa Riverwalk / Plant Hall
cards.notes: Use the museum as a history-focused final stop if it is open. Confirm admission and exhibit access before going, then connect what you saw back to Plant Hall’s campus history.
cards.short_summary: A Riverwalk-listed museum associated with the historic Plant-era setting.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa lists the Henry B. Plant Museum among museums along the Tampa Riverwalk.
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s official site for current admission, hours and visitor policies.

cards.title: End at Water Works Park
cards.subtitle: Sunday daylight · Tampa Riverwalk
cards.notes: Finish with a relaxed riverside walk or picnic-area break. The park connects to the Riverwalk and has open green space, shaded seating and waterfront views for a low-key close.
cards.short_summary: A public riverfront park with Riverwalk access and no admission fee.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa says Water Works Park is open to the public, connects to the Tampa Riverwalk and has no admission fee.
cards.source_title: Water Works Park | City of Tampa
cards.access_notes: City-listed hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; use the park during posted hours and follow park rules.
